# DirectShow base classes (vendored)

Unmodified copy of the DirectShow base classes from
[microsoft/Windows-classic-samples](https://github.com/microsoft/Windows-classic-samples/tree/434f6002bdf9cf9829406c3ff2b33387982d6168/Samples/Win7Samples/multimedia/directshow/baseclasses)
(commit `434f6002bdf9cf9829406c3ff2b33387982d6168`), MIT license — see `LICENSE`.
Only the `.cpp`/`.h` files are kept; the old Visual Studio project files are replaced by our CMake build.
